overview: Operation Greens is a scheme announced in the Union Budget 2018-19 with an outlay of Rs.500 crore to promote Farmer Producers Organizations (FPOs), agri-logistics, processing facilities and professional management for the development of Tomato, Onion and Potato and later expanded to 2018. The scheme has two components: (I) Long Term Intervention-Integrated Value Chain Development Projects and (II) Short-Term Interventions. It aims to stabilize supply and prices of TOP crops and reduce post-harvest losses.
objectives: Stabilize supply and prices of Tomato, Onion and Potato (TOP) crops
eligibility: The scheme is implemented for development of Tomato, Onion and Potato (TOP) value chain since November 2018. The scheme has two components namely (I) Long Term Intervention-Integrated Value Chain Development Projects and (II) Short-Term Interventions.
benefits: Promotion of Farmer Producers Organizations (FPOs), agri-logistics, processing facilities and professional management. Stabilization of supply and prices of TOP crops. Reduction of post-harvest losses.
financial_support: The scheme was announced with an outlay of Rs.500 crore in the Union Budget 2018-19 to promote Farmer Producers Organizations (FPOs), agri-logistics, processing facilities and professional management.
